description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests the behavior of Git hooks, specifically the post-merge hook, within a testing framework. It includes test setup, configuration, and assertions to verify that the hook executes correctly during Git merge operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test case completes.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up or verifies the configuration of Git hooks, specifically post-merge hooks in this context.
